exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus during COVID-19 pandemic wave I vs. wave III
cohort: Women with gestational diabetes mellitus during COVID-19 pandemic wave I (n=119) and wave III (n=116)
finding: While there were differences in clinical characteristics between women with GDM in wave I and wave III of the COVID-19 pandemic, nearly all pregnancy outcomes were similar.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean sections was similar between the two groups.
